title: Nasty Juice Modmate Red Apple Shortfill 50ml E-Liquid
description: Red Apple by Mod Mate from Nasty Juice is a classic red apple flavour that’s been meticulously crafted to bring out the soft sweetness and fresh deliciousness of real red apples, with none of the sharpness or candy notes you find with many green apple e-liquids. Smooth, juicy and utterly moreish, if you love apple flavours you can’t afford to miss this exquisite e-juice. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks. Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their high-VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-liquid helps ensure you don’t run out too quickly. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Juice Mod Mate flavours to try. Mod Mate are specially formulated freebase e-liquids that Nasty Juice have fine-tuned for optimised performance with all leading vape mod devices, as part of their ENDS collection. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and are available in 50ml shortfills for use with high-powered mods and pod kits. Make your mod your mate, with Mod Mate from Nasty Juice E-liquids.
